title: Illinois crypto tax is impossible to enforce as written, crypto industry tells court

title: DTCC adds Solana to Wall Street tokenization plans, targeting 2027 rollout
content: The securities infrastructure giant plans to bring tokenized stocks, ETFs and U.S. Treasuries to Solana as it expands next year's roadmap beyond Stellar and Arc.

title: Strategy stock sheds 5% amid MSCI index removal, Bitcoin sell-off

title: US Justice Department, business groups and DeFi firms challenge Illinois crypto tax
content: Industry groups argued in court filings that Illinois’ crypto tax, which applies even when a transaction yields no profit, could raise compliance costs and violate federal law.

title: Republican Senator Wants to Freeze AI Data Center Boom as Congress Pushes to Expand It
content: Senator Josh Hawley wants a nationwide construction pause until households are protected from rising power bills, even as Congress advances legislation designed to accelerate America's already massive AI infrastructure buildout.

title: North Korea Stole $400 Million in Crypto Using Deepfake Video Calls, DOJ Says
content: The FBI says the “FaceStealer” scheme uses prerecorded footage and AI deepfakes of trusted contacts to trick crypto workers into installing malware on video calls—as the DOJ also moves to seize $1.2 billion from the Binance hack.

title: Strategy Made $19.5 Billion in Profit. So Why Is MSCI Removing It From Stock Indexes?

title: DOJ’s Operation TorNado Arrests 354 and Seizes $234 Million in Cash and Crypto

title: Binance Says It Has Fully Covered the $6.34 Billion Hack With Company Funds
content: Bitcoin Magazine Binance Says It Has Fully Covered the $6.34 Billion Hack With Company Funds The exchange says users are whole after the Oct. 29 theft, paid for from SAFU, its futures insurance fund and treasury, and has published a 198-token proof-of-reserves snapshot that users cannot yet independently verify.
